criteria.pass_when: Already-open N and new N+1 connections read their own wire shapes and observe writes from both protocols before and after backfill. Unsupported protocol reads and writes raise ValueError without changing database state.
criteria.evidence: Executed reads/writes through both connections, including negative amount and original text preservation; unsupported read/write evidence includes ValueError and unchanged database state. A connection-open check alone is insufficient.

criteria.pass_when: A committed step persists; interruption between row write and checkpoint rolls back both. Reopen the same database, finish all rows, then repeat without omissions, duplicates or value changes.
criteria.evidence: Persisted row/checkpoint observations and exact final records across close/reopen; fresh database or only clean success is insufficient.

criteria.pass_when: Incomplete backfill cannot finalize. After draining clients and freezing writes, create and verify a pre-loss snapshot, finalize irreversibly, reject retired protocol and writes, restore, and recover exact original text. Snapshot remains usable.
criteria.evidence: Executed destructive step on disposable data, evidence raw no longer exists, then restoration including 001.20. Formatting 120 as 1.20 or lowering a schema version is not recovery.

criteria.pass_when: Report synthetic/offline evidence and missing native-product evidence accurately; no installation, deployment or production reads/writes.
criteria.evidence: Complete tool and user observations plus tests; omitted observation channels are unverified, not a pass.
